input: Get a professional posture assessment from a physio

gold.taskTitle: Get a Professional Posture Assessment from a Physio
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to book and attend a professional posture assessment with a physiotherapist.

questions.title: Do you already have a physiotherapist you see?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has an existing physio relationship or needs to find a new one.

questions.title: What specific posture concern is driving this?
questions.description: Understand the underlying reason, such as back pain, neck stiffness, desk posture, or general check-up.

questions.title: Do you need an in-person or telehealth appointment?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred or available format for the assessment.

questions.title: What is your rough location or preferred clinic area?
questions.description: Identify the geographic area to help narrow down suitable physiotherapy clinics.

questions.title: Do you have private health insurance covering physiotherapy?
questions.description: Determine whether cost and insurance coverage will affect the choice of provider.

questions.title: When do you want to have this assessment done by?
questions.description: Establish a target date or urgency level to prioritise the booking steps.

questions.title: Do you need a GP referral first in your situation?
questions.description: Clarify whether a referral is required for insurance, subsidy, or preferred provider access.
